sections.label: Book 5
sections.name: Soma's reception, the altar and the Soma sheds

verses.sa: अग्नेस्तनूरसि विष्णवे त्वा सोमस्य तनूरसि विष्णवे त्वा ऽतिथेरातिथ्यमसि विष्णवे त्वा श्येनाय त्वा सोमभृते विष्णवे त्वाऽग्नये त्वा रायस्पोषदे विष्णवे त्वा॥
verses.tr: agnestanūrasi viṣṇave tvā somasya tanūrasi viṣṇave tvā 'titherātithyamasi viṣṇave tvā śyenāya tvā somabhṛte viṣṇave tvā'gnaye tvā rāyaspoṣade viṣṇave tvā
verses.en: Body of Agni art thou. Thee for Vishnu. Body of Soma art thou. Thee for Vishnu. Thou art the Guest's Reception. Thee for Vishnu. Thee for the Soma-bringing Falcon. Thee for Vishnu. Thee for the giver of abundance, Agni. Thee for Vishnu.

verses.sa: अग्नेर्जनित्रमसि वृषणौ स्थ उर्वश्यस्यायुरसि पुरूरवा असि। गायत्रेण त्वा छन्दसा मन्थामि त्रैष्टुभेन त्वा छन्दसा मन्थामि जागतेन त्वा छन्दसा मन्थामि॥
verses.tr: agnerjanitramasi vṛṣaṇau stha urvaśyasyāyurasi purūravā asi gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā manthāmi traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā manthāmi jāgatena tvā chandasā manthāmi
verses.en: Birth-place art thou of Agni. Ye are sprinklers. Thou art Urvasi. Thou art Ayu. Thou art Pururavas. I rub and churn thee with Gayatri metre. I rub and churn thee with the Trishtup metre. I rub and churn thee with the Jagati metre.

verses.sa: भवतं नः समनसौ सचेतसावरेपसौ। मा यज्ञं हिंसिष्टं मा यज्ञपतिं जातवेदसौ शिवौ भवतमद्य नः॥
verses.tr: bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau sacetasāvarepasau mā yajñaṃ hiṃsiṣṭaṃ mā yajñapatiṃ jātavedasau śivau bhavatamadya naḥ
verses.en: Be ye for us one-minded, be one-thoughted, free from spot and stain. Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the sacrifice's lord. Be kind to us this day, Omniscient Ones!

verses.sa: अग्नावग्निश्चरति प्रविष्ट ऋषीणां पुत्रो अभिशस्तिपावा। स नः स्योनः सुयजा यजेह देवेभ्यो हव्यं सदमप्रयुच्छन्त्स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agnāvagniścarati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇāṃ putro abhiśastipāvā sa naḥ syonaḥ suyajā yajeha devebhyo havyaṃ sadamaprayucchantsvāhā
verses.en: Preserver from the curse, Son of the Rishis, Agni is active having entered Agni. Here for us kindly with fair worship offer oblation to the Gods with care unceasing. Svaha!

verses.sa: आपतये त्वा परिपतये गृह्णामि तनूनप्त्रे शाक्वराय शक्वन ओजिष्ठाय। अनाधृष्टमस्यनाधृष्यं देवानामोजोऽनभिशस्त्यभिशस्तिपा अनभिशस्तेन्यमञ्जसा सत्यमुपगेषं स्विते मा धाः॥
verses.tr: āpataye tvā paripataye gṛhṇāmi tanūnaptre śākvarāya śakvana ojiṣṭhāya anādhṛṣṭamasyanādhṛṣyaṃ devānāmojo'nabhiśastyabhiśastipā anabhiśastenyamañjasā satyamupageṣaṃ svite mā dhāḥ
verses.en: For him who flies around and rushes onward I take thee, for Tanunapat the mighty, the very strong, of all-surpassing vigour. Strength of the Gods, inviolate, inviolable still art thou, the strength that turns the curse away, uncursed and never to be cursed. May I go straight to truth. Place me in comfort.

verses.sa: अग्ने व्रतपास्त्वे व्रतपा या तव तनूरियं सा मयि यो मम तनूरेषा सा त्वयि। सह नौ व्रतपते व्रतान्यनु मे दीक्षां दीक्षापतिर्मन्यतामनु तपस्तपस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: agne vratapāstve vratapā yā tava tanūriyaṃ sā mayi yo mama tanūreṣā sā tvayi saha nau vratapate vratānyanu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatirmanyatāmanu tapastapaspatiḥ
verses.en: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, O Guardian of the Vow, in thee Whatever form there is of thine, may that same form be here on me: on thee be every form of mine. O Lord of Vows, let our vows be united. May Diksha's Lord allow my Consecration, may holy Fervour's Lord approve my Fervour.

verses.sa: अंशुरंशुष्टे देव सोमाप्यायतामिन्द्रायैकधनविदे। आ तुभ्यमिन्द्रः प्यायतामा त्वमिन्द्राय प्यायस्व। आ प्याययास्मान्त्सखीन्त्सन्या मेधया स्वस्ति ते देव सोम सुत्यामशीय। एष्टा रायः प्रेषे भगाय ऋतमृतवादिभ्यो नमो द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: aṃśuraṃśuṣṭe deva somāpyāyatāmindrāyaikadhanavide ā tubhyamindraḥ pyāyatāmā tvamindrāya pyāyasva ā pyāyayāsmāntsakhīntsanyā medhayā svasti te deva soma sutyāmaśīya eṣṭā rāyaḥ preṣe bhagāya ṛtamṛtavādibhyo namo dyāvāpṛthivībhyām
verses.en: May every stalk of thine wax full and strengthen for Indra Ekadhanavid, God Soma! May Indra grow in strength for thee: for Indra mayest thou grow strong. Increase us friends with strength and mental vigour. May all prosperity be thine, God Soma. May I attain the solemn Soma-pressing. May longed-for wealth come forth for strength and fortune. Let there be truth for those whose speech is truthful. To Heaven and Earth be adoration offered.

verses.sa: या ते अग्नेऽयःशया तनूर्वर्षिष्ठा गह्वरेष्ठा। उग्रं वचो अपावधीत्त्वेषं वचो अपावधीत्स्वाहा। या ते अग्ने रजःशया तनूर्वर्षिष्ठा गह्वरेष्ठा। उग्रं वचो अपावधीत्त्वेषं वचो अपावधीत्स्वाहा। या ते अग्ने हरिशया तनूर्वर्षिष्ठा गह्वरेष्ठा। उग्रं वचो अपावधीत्त्वेषं वचो अपावधीत्स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yā te agne'yaḥśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahvareṣṭhā ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīttveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā yā te agne rajaḥśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahvareṣṭhā ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīttveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā yā te agne hariśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahvareṣṭhā ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīttveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhītsvāhā
verses.en: That noblest body which is thine, O Agni, laid in the lowest deep, encased in iron, hath chased the awful word, the word of terror. Svahas! That noblest encased in silver, etc. Svaha That noblest. with gold around it, etc. Svaha

verses.sa: तप्तायनी मेऽसि वित्तायनी मेऽस्यवतान्मा नाथितादवतान्मा व्यथितात्। विदेदग्निर्नभो नामा ऽग्ने अङ्गिर आयुना नाम्नेहि योऽस्यां पृथिव्यामसि यत्तेऽनाधृष्टं नाम यज्ञियं तेन त्वा दधे विदेदग्निर्नभो नामा ऽग्ने अङ्गिर आयुना नाम्नेहि यो द्वितीयस्यां पृथिव्यामसि यत्तेऽनाधृष्टं नाम यज्ञियं तेन त्वा दधे विदेदग्निर्नभो नामा ऽग्ने अङ्गिर आयुना नाम्नेहि यस्तृतीयस्यां पृथिव्यामसि यत्तेऽनाधृष्टं नाम यज्ञियं तेन त्वा दधे। अनु त्वा देववीतये॥
verses.tr: taptāyanī me'si vittāyanī me'syavatānmā nāthitādavatānmā vyathitāt videdagnirnabho nāmā 'gne aṅgira āyunā nāmnehi yo'syāṃ pṛthivyāmasi yatte'nādhṛṣṭaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ tena tvā dadhe videdagnirnabho nāmā 'gne aṅgira āyunā nāmnehi yo dvitīyasyāṃ pṛthivyāmasi yatte'nādhṛṣṭaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ tena tvā dadhe videdagnirnabho nāmā 'gne aṅgira āyunā nāmnehi yastṛtīyasyāṃ pṛthivyāmasi yatte'nādhṛṣṭaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ tena tvā dadhe anu tvā devavītaye
verses.en: For me thou art the home of the afflicted. For me thou art the gathering-place of riches. Protect me from the woe of destitution. Protect me from the state of perturbation. May Agni know thee, he whose name is Nabhas. Go, Agni, Angiras, with the name of Ayu. Thou whom this earth containeth, down I lay thee with each inviolate holy name thou bearest. Thou whom the second earth, etc. Thou whom the third earth, etc. Thee, further, for the Gods' delight.

verses.sa: सिंह्यसि सपत्नसाही देवेभ्यः कल्पस्व सिंह्यसि सपत्नसाही देवेभ्यःशुन्धस्व सिंह्यसि सपत्नसाही देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व॥
verses.tr: siṃhyasi sapatnasāhī devebhyaḥ kalpasva siṃhyasi sapatnasāhī devebhyaḥśundhasva siṃhyasi sapatnasāhī devebhyaḥ śumbhasva
verses.en: A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be fitted for the Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: be purified for Gods. A foe-subduing lioness art thou: adorn thyself for Gods.

verses.sa: इन्द्रघोषस्त्वा वसुभिः पुरस्तात्पातु प्रचेतास्त्वा रुद्रैः पश्चात्पातु मनोजवास्त्वा पितृभिर्दक्षिणतः पातु विश्वकर्मा त्वाऽऽदित्यैरुत्तरतः पात्विदमहं तप्तं वार्बहिर्धा यज्ञान्निः सृजामि॥
verses.tr: indraghoṣastvā vasubhiḥ purastātpātu pracetāstvā rudraiḥ paścātpātu manojavāstvā pitṛbhirdakṣiṇataḥ pātu viśvakarmā tvā''dityairuttarataḥ pātvidamahaṃ taptaṃ vārbahirdhā yajñānniḥ sṛjāmi
verses.en: Indra's shout guard thee in the front with Vasus. The Wise One guard thee from the rear with Rudras. The Thought-swift guard thee on the right with Fathers. The Omnific guard thee, leftward, with Adityas. This heated water I eject and banish from the sacrifice.

verses.sa: सिंह्यसि स्वाहा सिंह्यस्यादित्यवनिः स्वाहा सिंह्यसि ब्रह्मवनिः क्षत्रवनिः स्वाहा सिंह्यसि सुप्रजावनी रायस्पोषवनिः स्वाहा सिंह्यस्यावह देवान् यजमानाय स्वाहा भूतेभ्यस्त्वा॥
verses.tr: siṃhyasi svāhā siṃhyasyādityavaniḥ svāhā siṃhyasi brahmavaniḥ kṣatravaniḥ svāhā siṃhyasi suprajāvanī rāyaspoṣavaniḥ svāhā siṃhyasyāvaha devān yajamānāya svāhā bhūtebhyastvā
verses.en: Thou art a lioness. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Adityas. All-hail! Thou art a lioness winning Brahmans and Nobles. All-hail! Thou art a lioness that wins fair offspring, win abundant wealth. All-hail! A lioness art thou. Bring the Gods hither for him who offers sacrifice. All-hail! To living creatures, thee.

verses.sa: ध्रुवोऽसि पृथिवीं दृंह ध्रुवक्षिदस्यन्तरिक्षं दृंहाच्युतक्षिदसि दिवं दृंहाग्नेः पुरीषमसि॥
verses.tr: dhruvo'si pṛthivīṃ dṛṃha dhruvakṣidasyantarikṣaṃ dṛṃhācyutakṣidasi divaṃ dṛṃhāgneḥ purīṣamasi
verses.en: Firm art thou, steady thou the earth. Firm seated art thou, steady thou the air. Movelessly set art thou, steady the sky. Agni's completion art thou.

verses.sa: युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः। वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ svāhā
verses.en: The priests of him the lofty Priest well-skilled in hymns harness their spirits, yea harness their holy thoughts. He only knowing works assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God. All-hail!

verses.sa: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम्। समूढमस्य पांसुरे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā
verses.en: Forth through This All strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole was gathered in his footstep's dust. All-hail!

verses.sa: इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतं सूयवसिनी मनवे दशस्या। व्यस्कभ्ना रोदसी विष्णवेते दाधर्थ पृथिवीमभितो मयूखैः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtaṃ sūyavasinī manave daśasyā vyaskabhnā rodasī viṣṇavete dādhartha pṛthivīmabhito mayūkhaiḥ svāhā
verses.en: Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fain to do men service. Both these worlds, Vishnu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed, the earth with pegs around it.

verses.sa: देवश्रुतौ देवेष्वा घोषतं प्राची प्रेतमध्वरं कल्पयन्ती ऊर्ध्वं यज्ञं नयतं मा जिह्वरतम्। स्वं गोष्ठमा वदतं देवी दुर्ये आयुर्मा निर्वादिष्टं प्रजां मा निर्वादिष्टमत्र रमेथां वर्ष्मन् पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: devaśrutau deveṣvā ghoṣataṃ prācī pretamadhvaraṃ kalpayantī ūrdhvaṃ yajñaṃ nayataṃ mā jihvaratam svaṃ goṣṭhamā vadataṃ devī durye āyurmā nirvādiṣṭaṃ prajāṃ mā nirvādiṣṭamatra ramethāṃ varṣman pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Heard by the Gods, ye twain, to Gods proclaim it. Go eastward, O ye twain, proclaiming worship. Swerve ye not: bear the sacrifice straight; upward. To your own cow-pen speak, ye godlike dwellings. Speak not away my life, speak not away my children. On the earth's summit here may ye be joyful.

verses.sa: विष्णोर्नुकं वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि। यो अस्कभायदुत्तरं सधस्थं विचक्रमाणस्त्रेधोरुगायो विष्णवे त्वा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyo viṣṇave tvā
verses.en: Now will I tell the mighty deeds of Vishnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions. Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his foot and widely striding. For Vishnu thee.

verses.sa: दिवो वा विष्ण उत वा पृथिव्या महो वा विष्ण उरोरन्तरिक्षात्। उभा हि हस्ता वसुना पृणस्वा प्र यच्छ दक्षिणादोत सव्याद्विष्णवे त्वा॥
verses.tr: divo vā viṣṇa uta vā pṛthivyā maho vā viṣṇa urorantarikṣāt ubhā hi hastā vasunā pṛṇasvā pra yaccha dakṣiṇādota savyādviṣṇave tvā
verses.en: Either from heaven or from the earth, O Vishnu, or, Vishnu, from the vast wide air's mid-region, Fill both thy hands full with abundant riches, and from the right and from the left bestow them. For Vishnu thee.

verses.sa: प्र तद्विष्णु स्तवते वीर्येण मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः। यस्योरुषु त्रिषु विक्रमणेष्वधिक्षियन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: pra tadviṣṇu stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: For this his mighty deed is Vishnu lauded, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming. He within whose three wide-extended paces all living creatures have their habitation.

verses.sa: विष्णो रराटमसि विष्णोः श्नप्त्रे स्थो विष्णोः स्यूरसि विष्णोर्ध्रुवोऽसि। वैष्णवमसि विष्णवे त्वा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇo rarāṭamasi viṣṇoḥ śnaptre stho viṣṇoḥ syūrasi viṣṇordhruvo'si vaiṣṇavamasi viṣṇave tvā
verses.en: Thou art the frontlet for the brow of Vishnu. Ye are the corners of the mouth of Vishnu. Thou art the needle for the work of Vishnu. Thou art the firmly-fastened knot of Vishnu. To Vishnu thou belongest. Thee for Vishnu.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे नार्यसीदमहं रक्षसां ग्रीवा अपि कृन्तामि। बृहन्नसि बृहद्रवा बृहतीमिन्द्राय वाचं वद॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade nāryasīdamahaṃ rakṣasāṃ grīvā api kṛntāmi bṛhannasi bṛhadravā bṛhatīmindrāya vācaṃ vada
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitars I take thee with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pushan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Rakshasas away. Mighty art thou, mighty the sound thou makest. Utter thy mighty-sounding voice to Indra:

verses.sa: रक्षोहणं वलगहनं वैष्णवी मिदमहं तं वलगमुत्किरामि यं मे निष्ट्यो यममात्यो निचखानेदमहं तं वलगमुत्किरामि यं मे समानो यमसमानो निचखानेदमहं तं वलगमुत्किरामि यं मे सबन्धुर्यमसबन्धुर्निचखानेदमहं तं वलगमुत्किरामि यं मे सजातो यमसजातो निचखानोत्कृत्यां किरामि॥
verses.tr: rakṣohaṇaṃ valagahanaṃ vaiṣṇavī midamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me niṣṭyo yamamātyo nicakhānedamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me samāno yamasamāno nicakhānedamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me sabandhuryamasabandhurnicakhānedamahaṃ taṃ valagamutkirāmi yaṃ me sajāto yamasajāto nicakhānotkṛtyāṃ kirāmi
verses.en: Fiend-killing, charm-destroying voice of Vishnu. Here I cast out that charm of magic power which stranger or housemate for me hath buried. Here I cast out the charm of magic power buried for me by equal or unequal. Here I cast out the charm that hath been buried for me by non-relation or relation. I cast the charm of magic out.

verses.sa: स्वराडसि सपत्नहा सत्रराडस्यभिमातिहा जनराडसि रक्षोहा सर्वराडस्यमित्रहा॥
verses.tr: svarāḍasi sapatnahā satrarāḍasyabhimātihā janarāḍasi rakṣohā sarvarāḍasyamitrahā
verses.en: Self-ruler art thou, conquering foes. Ruler for ever art thou, killing enemies. Men's ruler art thou, slaying fiends. All ruler, killing foes, art thou.

verses.sa: रक्षोहणो वो वलगहनः प्रोक्षामि वैष्णवान् रक्षोहणो वो वलगहनोऽवनयामि वैष्णवान् रक्षोहणो वो वलगहनोऽवस्तृणामि वैष्णवान् रक्षोहणौ वां वलगहना उप दधामि वैष्णवी रक्षोहणौ वां वलगहनौ पर्यूहामि वैष्णवी वैष्णवमसि वैष्णवा स्थ॥
verses.tr: rakṣohaṇo vo valagahanaḥ prokṣāmi vaiṣṇavān rakṣohaṇo vo valagahano'vanayāmi vaiṣṇavān rakṣohaṇo vo valagahano'vastṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavān rakṣohaṇau vāṃ valagahanā upa dadhāmi vaiṣṇavī rakṣohaṇau vāṃ valagahanau paryūhāmi vaiṣṇavī vaiṣṇavamasi vaiṣṇavā stha
verses.en: I sprinkle you whom Vishnu owns, killers of fiends and evil charms. I lay down you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. I scatter you whom Vishnu loves, killers of fiends and wicked charms. You two whom Vishnu loves, who kill fiends and ill charms do I lay down. You two whom Vishnu loves, who kill fiends and ill charms I compass round. To Vishnu thou belongest. Ye are Vishnu's.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे नार्यसीदमहं रक्षसां ग्रीवा अपि कृन्तामि। यवोऽसि यवयास्मद्द्वेषो यवयारातीर्दिवे त्वाऽन्तरिक्षाय त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वा शुन्धन्तांल्लोकाः पितृषदनाः पितृषदनमसि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade nāryasīdamahaṃ rakṣasāṃ grīvā api kṛntāmi yavo'si yavayāsmaddveṣo yavayārātīrdive tvā'ntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā śundhantāṃllokāḥ pitṛṣadanāḥ pitṛṣadanamasi
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pushan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Rakshasas away. Barley art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies. Thee for heaven, thee for earth, thee for air's region. Pure be the worlds, the Fathers' dwelling-places. Thou art the habitation of the Fathers.

verses.sa: उद्दिवं स्तभानान्तरिक्षं पृण दृंहस्व पृथिव्याम् द्युतानास्त्वा मारुतो मिनोतु मित्रावरुणौ ध्रुवेण धर्मणा। ब्रह्मवनि त्वा क्षत्रवनि रायस्पोषवनि पर्यूहामि। ब्रह्म दृंह क्षत्रं दृंहायुर्दृंह प्रजां दृंह॥
verses.tr: uddivaṃ stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa dṛṃhasva pṛthivyām dyutānāstvā māruto minotu mitrāvaruṇau dhruveṇa dharmaṇā brahmavani tvā kṣatravani rāyaspoṣavani paryūhāmi brahma dṛṃha kṣatraṃ dṛṃhāyurdṛṃha prajāṃ dṛṃha
verses.en: Prop heaven, fill full the air, on earth stand firmly. Dyutina, offspring of the Maruts, plant thee!, Mitra and Varuna with firm upholding. I cl close thee in, thou winner of the Brahmans, winner of Nobles and abundant riches. Strengthen the Brahmans, strengthen thou the Nobles, strengthen our vital power, strengthen our offspring.

verses.sa: ध्रुवासि ध्रुवोऽयं यजमानोऽस्मिन्नायतने प्रजया पशुभिर्भूयात्। घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी पूर्येथामिन्द्रस्य छदिरसि विश्वजनस्य छाया॥
verses.tr: dhruvāsi dhruvo'yaṃ yajamāno'sminnāyatane prajayā paśubhirbhūyāt ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī pūryethāmindrasya chadirasi viśvajanasya chāyā
verses.en: Firm-set art thou. Firm be this Sacrificer within this home with offspring and with cattle. O Heaven and Earth, be ye filled full of fatness. Indra's mat art thou, shelter of all people.

verses.sa: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतः। वृद्धायुमनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयः॥
verses.tr: pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvataḥ vṛddhāyumanu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Lover of song, may these our songs encompass thee on every side; Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य स्यूरसीन्द्रस्य ध्रुवोऽसि। ऐन्द्रमसि वैश्वदेवमसि॥
verses.tr: indrasya syūrasīndrasya dhruvo'si aindramasi vaiśvadevamasi
verses.en: Thou art the needle for the work of Indra. Thou art the firmly fastened knot of Indra. Indra's art thou. Thou art the Visvedevas'.

verses.sa: विभूरसि प्रवाहणो वह्निरसि हव्यवाहनः। श्वात्रोऽसि प्रचेतास्तुथोऽसि विश्ववेदाः॥
verses.tr: vibhūrasi pravāhaṇo vahnirasi havyavāhanaḥ śvātro'si pracetāstutho'si viśvavedāḥ
verses.en: All-present art thou, carrying off. Oblation-bearing priest art thou. Thou art the Swift, the Very Wise. Tutha art thou, who knoweth all.

verses.sa: उशिगसि कविरङ्घारिरसि बम्भारिरवस्यूरसि दुवस्वाञ्छुन्ध्यूरसि मार्जालीयः सम्राडसि कृशानुः परिषद्योऽसि पवमानो नभोऽसि प्रतक्वा मृष्टोऽसि हव्यसूदन ऋतधामाऽसि स्वर्ज्योतिः॥
verses.tr: uśigasi kaviraṅghārirasi bambhāriravasyūrasi duvasvāñchundhyūrasi mārjālīyaḥ samrāḍasi kṛśānuḥ pariṣadyo'si pavamāno nabho'si pratakvā mṛṣṭo'si havyasūdana ṛtadhāmā'si svarjyotiḥ
verses.en: Thou art the yearning one, the sage. Anghari, Bambhari art thou. Aid-seeker art thou, worshipping. Cleanser art thou, the cleansing-place. Krishna, Sovran Lord, art thou. Thou art the Pavamana of the assembly. Thou art the welkin ever moving forward. Swept clean art thou, preparer of oblations. Thou art the seat of Law, heaven's light and lustre.

verses.sa: समुद्रोऽसि विश्वव्यचा अजोऽस्येकपादहिरसि बुध्न्यो वागस्यैन्द्रमसि सदोऽस्यृतस्य द्वारौ मा मा सनताप्तमध्वनामध्वपते प्र मा तिर स्वस्ति मेऽस्मिन्पथि देवयाने भूयात्॥
verses.tr: samudro'si viśvavyacā ajo'syekapādahirasi budhnyo vāgasyaindramasi sado'syṛtasya dvārau mā mā sanatāptamadhvanāmadhvapate pra mā tira svasti me'sminpathi devayāne bhūyāt
verses.en: A sea art thou of all-embracing compass. Aja art thou, who hath one foot to bear him. Thou art the Dragon of the Depths of ocean. Speech art thou, thou the Sadas, thou art Indra's. Doors of the sacrifice, do not distress me! Lord, Ruler of the pathways, lead me onward. In this Godreaching path may I be happy.

verses.sa: मित्रस्य मा चक्षुषेक्षध्वमग्नयः सगराः सगरा स्थ सगरेण नाम्ना रौद्रेणानीकेन पात माऽग्नयः पिपृत माऽग्नयो गोपायत मा नमो वोऽस्तु मा मा हिंसिष्ट॥
verses.tr: mitrasya mā cakṣuṣekṣadhvamagnayaḥ sagarāḥ sagarā stha sagareṇa nāmnā raudreṇānīkena pāta mā'gnayaḥ pipṛta mā'gnayo gopāyata mā namo vo'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa
verses.en: Look ye upon me with the eye of Mitra. O Agnis, ye, receivers of oblations, are by a lauded name lauded together. Protect me, Agnis! with your glittering army. Fill me with riches, Agnis! be my keepers. To you be adoration. Do not harm me.

verses.sa: ज्योतिरसि विश्वरूपं विश्वेषां देवानां समित्। त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्य उरु यन्तासि वरूथं स्वाहा जुषाणो अप्तुराज्यस्य वेतु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: jyotirasi viśvarūpaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ samit tvaṃ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo'nyakṛtebhya uru yantāsi varūthaṃ svāhā juṣāṇo apturājyasya vetu svāhā
verses.en: Thou art a light that wears all forms and figures, serving the general host of Gods as Kindler. Thou, Soma, wilt withhold thy wide protection from body-wounding hatreds shown by others. All-hail! Let the Swift graciously enjoy the butter. All-hail!

verses.sa: अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान्। युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नम उक्तिं विधेम॥
verses.tr: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema
verses.en: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sa: अयं नो अग्निर्वरिवस्कृणोत्वयं मृधः पुर एतु प्रभिन्दन्। अयं वाजाञ्जयतु वाजसातावयं शत्रूञ्जयतु जर्हृषाणः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ no agnirvarivaskṛṇotvayaṃ mṛdhaḥ pura etu prabhindan ayaṃ vājāñjayatu vājasātāvayaṃ śatrūñjayatu jarhṛṣāṇaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: May he quell foes in his triumphant onset.

verses.sa: उरु विष्णो वि क्रमस्वोरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि। घृतं घृतयोने पिब प्रप्र यज्ञपतिं तिर स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya naskṛdhi ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā
verses.en: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, give ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All-hail!

verses.sa: देव सवितरेष ते सोमस्तं रक्षस्व मा त्वा दभन्। एतत्त्वं देव सोम देवो देवाँ२ उपागा इदमहं मनुष्यान्त्सह रायस्पोषेण स्वाहा निर्वरुणस्य पाशान्मुच्ये॥
verses.tr: deva savitareṣa te somastaṃ rakṣasva mā tvā dabhan etattvaṃ deva soma devo devāṃ2 upāgā idamahaṃ manuṣyāntsaha rāyaspoṣeṇa svāhā nirvaruṇasya pāśānmucye
verses.en: To the God Savitar, belongs this Soma. Guard him securely: let not demons harm thee. Now hast thou joined the Gods as God, God Soma: men have joined here through abundant riches. All-hail! from Varuna's noose am I delivered.

verses.sa: अग्ने व्रतपास्त्वे व्रतपा या तव तनूर्मय्यभूदेषा सा त्वयि यो मम तनूस्त्वय्यभूदियं सा मयि। यथायथं नौ व्रतपते व्रतान्यनु मे दीक्षां दीक्षापतिरमंस्तानु तपस्तपस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: agne vratapāstve vratapā yā tava tanūrmayyabhūdeṣā sā tvayi yo mama tanūstvayyabhūdiyaṃ sā mayi yathāyathaṃ nau vratapate vratānyanu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatiramaṃstānu tapastapaspatiḥ
verses.en: O Agni, Guardian of the Vow, Guardian of the Vow, on me whatever form of thine hath been, may that same form be upon thee. Whatever form of mine hath been on thee, may that be here on me. O Lord of Vows, our vows have been accomplished. Diksha's Lord hath approved my Consecration, and holy Fervour's Lord allowed my Fervour.

verses.sa: उरु विष्णो वि क्रमस्वोरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि। घृतं घृतयोने पिब प्रप्र यज्ञपतिं तिर स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya naskṛdhi ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā
verses.en: O Vishnu, stride thou widely forth, make ample room for our abode. Drink butter, homed in butter! Still speed on the sacrifice's lord. All-hail!

verses.sa: अत्यन्याँ२ अगां नान्याँ२ उपागामर्वाक् त्वा परेभ्योऽविदं परोऽवरेभ्यः। तं त्वा जुषामहे देव वनस्पते देवयज्यायै देवास्त्वा देवयज्यायै जुषन्तां विष्णवे त्वा। ओषधे त्रायस्व स्वधिते मैनं हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: atyanyāṃ2 agāṃ nānyāṃ2 upāgāmarvāk tvā parebhyo'vidaṃ paro'varebhyaḥ taṃ tvā juṣāmahe deva vanaspate devayajyāyai devāstvā devayajyāyai juṣantāṃ viṣṇave tvā oṣadhe trāyasva svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: I have passed others, not approached to others. On the near side of those that were more distant, and farther than the nearer have I found thee. So, for the worship of the Gods, with gladness we welcome thee God, Sovran of the Forest! Let the Gods welcome thee for the Gods' service. For Vishnu thee. Plant, guard! Axe, do not harm it!

verses.sa: द्यां मा लेखीरन्तरिक्षं मा हिंसीः पृथिव्या सम्भव। अयं हि त्वा स्वधितिस्तेतिजानः प्रणिनाय महते सौभगाय। अतस्त्वं देव वनस्पते शतवल्शो वि रोह सहस्रवल्शा वि वयं रुहेम॥
verses.tr: dyāṃ mā lekhīrantarikṣaṃ mā hiṃsīḥ pṛthivyā sambhava ayaṃ hi tvā svadhitistetijānaḥ praṇināya mahate saubhagāya atastvaṃ deva vanaspate śatavalśo vi roha sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhema
verses.en: Graze not the sky. Harm not mid-air. Be in accordance with the earth. For this well-sharpened axe hath led thee forth to great felicity. Hence, with a hundred branches, God, Lord of the Forest, grow thou up. May we grow spreading with a hundred branches.
